title: Function Interface Prober and Contract-aware Traffic Slicer
creator: Aisha Kumar
success_criteria: False positive rate for contract-breaking alerts <= 4% on historical evaluation set
Recall for injected-breaking changes >= 92% in synthetic bench
Canary traffic ramp controlled to <= 10% of requests for first 48h and auto-scaled based on confidence
Automatic rollback runbook triggers within 2m of threshold breach and completes mitigation within SLA window
design_notes: Prober component: a lightweight agent that executes interface probes in shadow mode and records execution fingerprints (call graph, final types, exception class, latency buckets)
Contract-aware diff: combine structural diffs (missing/extra fields, type mismatches) with semantic signals (field-value distributions, categorical shifts, sample-level function-token mismatches)
Execution fingerprinting: canonicalize response traces and compute stable hashes; flag large entropy shifts across model variants
Fuzz harness: generate edge-case payloads (max tokens, empty optional fields, swapped types) and run against shadow model to catch runtime exceptions and crash signatures
Traffic slicer: policy engine that can route by request features (route path, presence of toolcall metadata, prompt templates) and adapt slice size by confidence score
Rollback policy: multi-signal scoring (schema diff severity, execution error rate, semantic drift percentile, latency delta) with weighted thresholds and hysteresis to avoid flip-flopping
Data privacy: probes use sanitized synthetic inputs by default; for customer-owned prompts we only use deterministic sampling masks under customer's opt-in
Observability: expose per-slice metrics and sample diff store for fast repro and for SRE/PM triage
rollout_plan: Phase 0: offline eval on historical prompts and synthetic edgecases (2 days)
Phase 1: shadow-only run for 24-48h on 100% traffic, capture prober telemetry (no routing) to calibrate scoring thresholds
Phase 2: start traffic slicing at 0.5% of requests for highest-confidence slice for 1h, then 2%, 5%, up to 10% over 48h if confidence meets thresholds
Phase 3: broaden slice to additional request categories (A/B arms) and monitor cross-slice parity scores; require 3 continuous hours of green signals before full rollout
Auto-revert triggers: schema-severance > 0.5% of calls, execution-exception-rate increase > 300% over baseline, or latency p95 increase > 200ms sustained for 5m
Manual review gates: any customer-impacting change requires PM or SRE approval before >25% traffic will be directed to canary
telemetry_events: cts.probe.response_fingerprint -- canonical trace hash and metadata
cts.slice.size -- percent of traffic in slice
cts.fuzz.exception -- fuzz-case id and exception class
cts.latency.delta -- p50/p95 delta between baseline and canary
